titulo.alumno: A historical fact · Denmark in short texts

intro: Part 3: a historical fact. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In a short factual text, distinguish the verifiable fact from the explanation. Pay attention to proper names, dates and time connectors; do not deduce a general rule from a single example.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
